name.en: New York State Route 30 — the Adirondack Trail
name.zh: 纽约 30 号州道（阿迪朗达克小径）

tagline.en: Southern Tier to Quebec, straight through both forest preserves
tagline.zh: 自南部层地至魁北克，径直穿过两片森林保护区

start.en: NY 17 at Hancock in the Southern Tier
start.zh: 南部层地汉考克的 NY 17

end.en: The Canadian border at Constable, where it continues as Quebec Route 138
end.zh: 康斯特布尔的加拿大边境，续接魁北克 138 号公路

en: NY 30 is the route that goes through the middle of the Adirondacks rather than around them. It starts at NY 17 in the Southern Tier at Hancock, runs north-east past the Pepacton Reservoir at the edge of the Catskill Park, crosses the Schoharie country and US 20, and reaches the Mohawk at Amsterdam, where it meets the Thruway.

North of Amsterdam it enters the Adirondack Park and stays in it for well over a hundred miles: Mayfield, Northville, Wells, Speculator, Indian Lake, Blue Mountain Lake, Long Lake, Tupper Lake, Paul Smiths. It runs with NY 8 at Speculator and NY 28 at Indian Lake and Blue Mountain Lake, so the three routes braid through the same lake country.

It leaves the park near Paul Smiths, descends to Malone and US 11, and ends at the Canadian border at Constable, where it becomes Quebec Route 138 — a road that goes on through Montreal and up the north shore of the St Lawrence.
zh: NY 30 是那条从阿迪朗达克中间穿过、而非绕行的路线。它自南部层地汉考克的 NY 17 起，向东北经过卡茨基尔公园边缘的佩帕克顿水库，穿过斯科哈里一带与 US 20，抵达阿姆斯特丹的莫霍克河畔，并在此与收费高速公路相接。
阿姆斯特丹以北，它进入阿迪朗达克公园，并在其中停留一百多英里：梅菲尔德、诺思维尔、韦尔斯、斯佩克尤莱特、印第安湖、蓝山湖、长湖、塔珀湖、保罗史密斯。它在斯佩克尤莱特与 NY 8 共线，在印第安湖与蓝山湖与 NY 28 共线，三条路线在同一片湖区里彼此编织。
它在保罗史密斯附近离开公园，下行至马隆与 US 11，最终在康斯特布尔抵达加拿大边境，变成魁北克 138 号公路——那条路继续穿过蒙特利尔，沿圣劳伦斯河北岸而上。

en: The Adirondack portion is a designated state scenic byway. NYSDOT lists the Adirondack Trail as 188 miles connecting Fonda and Malone, with scenic, recreational and natural intrinsic qualities — the byway takes in NY 30A at the southern end as well as NY 30 itself.

The department's description is unusually restrained for byway literature: a park with glacial lakes and ponds scattered through it, skiing, boating and hiking, and a road that reaches from one side to the other. That is what it is. The traffic is light, the villages are small, and there are long stretches where the only thing between one hamlet and the next is forest preserve.

Hamilton County, which the route crosses lengthwise, is the third largest county in New York by area and the smallest by population. That is the most useful single fact for anyone planning fuel stops.
zh: 阿迪朗达克段是一条指定的州级风景道。纽约州交通部将「阿迪朗达克小径」列为连接丰达与马隆的 188 英里路线，具备风景、游憩与自然三项内在特质——该风景道在南端还纳入了 NY 30A，而不仅是 NY 30 本身。
对风景道宣传文字而言，该部门的描述异常克制：一座散布着冰川湖泊与池塘的公园，可滑雪、划船与徒步，还有一条自一侧通往另一侧的道路。事实就是如此。车流稀少，村镇很小，有很长的路段上，两个聚落之间除了森林保护区别无他物。
路线纵向穿过的汉密尔顿县，按面积是纽约州第三大县，按人口则是最小的一个。对任何规划加油点的人来说，这是最有用的一条事实。

en: NY 30 dates from the 1930 statewide renumbering, and unlike most long New York routes it has kept roughly the same job ever since: a north–south spine through the middle of the state's mountain country.

Almost all of it is state-maintained. NYSDOT looks after every part of the route except a short section in the city of Amsterdam, from Prospect Street two blocks north of NY 67 to the northern city line, which the city maintains.

Its continuation across the border is out of all proportion to the New York route. Quebec Route 138 runs for hundreds of miles beyond Constable, through Montreal and down the north shore of the St Lawrence — so NY 30 is, in effect, the southern tail of a very long Canadian highway.
zh: NY 30 始于 1930 年的全州重新编号；与多数纽约长途路线不同，它此后大体一直做着同一件事：作为一条纵贯该州山区腹地的南北脊线。
它几乎全部由州养护。纽约州交通部负责路线的每一部分，唯独阿姆斯特丹市内一小段除外——自 NY 67 以北两个街区的普罗斯佩克特街至市界北缘，由市政府养护。
它在边境另一侧的延续，与纽约这段完全不成比例。魁北克 138 号公路自康斯特布尔往北绵延数百英里，穿过蒙特利尔，沿圣劳伦斯河北岸而下——因此 NY 30 实际上是一条极长的加拿大公路的南端尾巴。

value.zh: 阿姆斯特丹市养护自普罗斯佩克特街至市界北缘的路段

figures.source: NYSDOT highway maintenance jurisdiction records, as summarised in the route's published description

why.en: NYSDOT publishes highway mileage by jurisdiction and county rather than by touring route, and no state-published total for NY 30 could be verified this session.
why.zh: 纽约州交通部按管辖主体与县发布公路里程，而非按巡游路线；本次未能查证到该州公布的 NY 30 总里程。

timeline.en: NY 30 is designated in the statewide renumbering.
timeline.zh: NY 30 在全州重新编号中划定。
